scope: Author-approved revised compass map; NSWE; -1..-6 dynamic gates. See docs/caverns-map-audit.md.

descriptions.1: You are in a darkened room inside a small bark hut. A door leads north to a forest clearing.
descriptions.2: You stand before a small windowless bark hut. The door to the south locked when you closed it. A forest lies west and a field of clovers opens east.
descriptions.3: You are deep in a dark forest. A mighty river glints through the trees. A path leads east to a hut clearing and west towards a river cliff.
descriptions.4: You stand in a field of four-leafed clovers. A hut clearing lies west and the slopes of Mount Ymir rise to the east.
descriptions.5: The forest opens onto a cliff above a wide glacial river. A foot-beaten path leads south to the riverbank. A forest path leads east.
descriptions.6: You stand at the rocky edge of the mighty river Gioll. A path forks east and west. Another climbs north to a cliff.
descriptions.7: You stand on the slippery rim of an enormous crater. Clouds of water vapour rise as the Gioll pours into it. West is a fatal drop. A safe path leads east.
descriptions.8: You are on a rocky outcrop fifteen feet above the river. A tiny string bridge spans the water to the south-east. To reach it you must go west and detour through the forest.
descriptions.9: You are on the lower slopes of Mount Ymir. Arctic winds blow fiercely. It is very cold! A path leads west through clovers towards the forest and south towards a bridge.
descriptions.10: You stand on a rocky precipice high above the Gioll. Mount Ymir rises to the north. A flimsy string bridge spans the river to the south.
descriptions.11: You are halfway across a creaking bridge. It sways violently above the river! Hold tight and follow it either north or south.
descriptions.12: You stand on the southern bank of the mighty river. A string bridge leads north. An oak forest lies west and a path follows the bank east to a cliff face.
descriptions.13: You stand on a rock in a mighty oak forest surrounded by thousands of poisonous mushrooms. A path leads east to a bridge landing and south to a clearing.
descriptions.14: You are in a forest clearing beneath an ancient basalt rock formation. A VERY interesting cave opens to the south... A path leads north into the oak forest.
descriptions.15: You are on a shelf against a cliff face above the southern riverbank. A path leads west to a string bridge landing.
descriptions.16: You are just inside a cave. Sunlight lights paths east and south. I don't mind saying I'm a bit scared! North leads outside. You will need a light to venture deeper.
descriptions.17: This passage appears to be a dead end. An earlier explorer scratched a message on the wall: 'Find the Sacred Key of Thialfi'. A passage leads west to the cave entrance.
descriptions.18: You are in a dark cavern. Daylight filters in from a cave entrance to the north. A passage leads west towards an old torture chamber.
descriptions.19: You are in the legendary treasure room of the black elves of Svartalfheim. Every red-blooded Viking dreams of entering this sacred room! A doorway leads west.
descriptions.20: You stand before an entrance to a treasure room. A passage leads south to a cavern.
descriptions.21: You are in a dark cavern. A passage leads north to an oak doorway. A draught comes from a corridor east. A long tunnel stretches south into darkness.
descriptions.22: You are in a corridor. A faint breeze stirs the stale air. West leads to a dark cavern and a doorway south leads to a torture chamber.
descriptions.23: This was once a torture chamber. Instruments of inhuman agony, coagulated blood on the walls and mangled bones on the floor suggest many adventurers croaked it here! A corridor leads north. A cavern near the cave entrance lies east.
descriptions.24: You stand in a long tunnel bored through the rock. It runs north to a cavern and south to a large round chamber.
descriptions.25: You are in a small silent side cave. Its only passage leads west to a large round chamber.
descriptions.26: You are in a large round room with mystical dark purple walls. A big chalk star marks the centre of the floor. This is a hidden chamber of the infamous monks of Loki. Norse folk believe them to be gods. A long tunnel leads north and a river ledge lies south. A passage west leads towards bat caves. A small side cave opens east.
descriptions.27: You stand on a narrow ledge high above a subterranean river. A balcony overlooks a huge cavern to the east. A passage leads north to a round chamber.
descriptions.28: You are on a balcony above a cavern converted into a temple to Loki. Odin banished the god of fire to Svartalfheim. Here he waits for the 'End Of All Things'. A sturdy stone rail borders the balcony above the temple floor. A passage leads west to a river ledge.
descriptions.29: You are in a dark cavern where passages meet. A draught stirs the air. A round chamber lies east and a bat colony lies south. A forked stone pillar marks a passage west.
descriptions.30: You are beside a forked stone pillar in a dark cavern. A junction lies east and a passage leads west to a pale limestone chamber.
descriptions.31: Water drips from the roof of a low dark passage. It leads north to a pale limestone chamber and east to another chamber.
descriptions.32: Pale limestone walls catch the light in this dark cavern. A passage leads east to a forked stone pillar and a low dripping passage leads south.
descriptions.33: You are in the heart of a giant bat colony. Hundreds hang overhead above centuries of bat droppings. Careful where you step! The smell is indescribable. A junction lies north and a passage leads west to another chamber.
descriptions.34: You are in a dark cavern. Passages lead east towards roosting bats and west into a low dripping passage.
descriptions.35: You are in the temple. A giant statue of Loki is carved out of the living rock of the wall itself! A balcony stands high overhead.
descriptions.36: You are in a dark cavern below a temple. A shaft opens north. A passage east leads towards the sound of an underground river.
descriptions.37: You stand in a musty crypt where hundreds of Loki's devotees lie in putrefaction and decay. Four stones in the eastern wall name its keeper. A gate leads south to a temple.
descriptions.38: You are in a tiny cell. A passage leads west to a crypt. A ventilation shaft pierces the eastern wall. A service hatch lies north but its latch is on the drain side.
descriptions.39: You are in a dark cavern beside a ventilation shaft. The shaft leads west to a cell. A passage leads south into a lower cavern.
descriptions.40: You stand on a ledge high above a subterranean river. Water pours through a hole in the roof to the north. A path leads north to the waterfall and south to a river bend. A cavern lies west. East is a sheer drop.
descriptions.41: Somehow you have found the drains of this entire cavern network! This drain leads west to a freezing conduit and east towards a junction.
descriptions.42: You are in the drains of a cavern network. A straight passage leads west towards a conduit and east to a junction.
descriptions.43: You stand at a drain junction. A winding passage leads north towards a pearl-white chamber. A branch runs east. A drain leads west towards a conduit. The cell's service hatch lies south with its latch on this side.
descriptions.44: You are in a blind branch of the cavern drains. There is no way onwards. A drain leads west to a junction.
descriptions.45: An enormous waterfall brings water down from the surface river Gioll. Stone steps climb north beside it. A ledge lies south. There is no safe footing east.
descriptions.46: Your light catches pearl-white walls in a dark cavern. Stone steps lie west. A winding passage leads south to a drain junction below.
descriptions.47: You stand atop a stone staircase. Steps descend south towards a roaring waterfall. A pearl-white chamber lies east.
descriptions.48: You stand on a crumbling river ledge. Across the water to the east is a magic castle. Don't ask me why it is magic... I just know it is! A drawbridge crosses east. A path leads north to another ledge. There is no path south.
descriptions.49: You stand on a mighty golden drawbridge above the river. Beyond it is a magic castle! A river ledge lies west and the courtyard lies east.
descriptions.50: You are in the courtyard of a magic castle. WOW! This castle is really something! The wall reads 'hzb tzozi'. A drawbridge lies west and a doorway leads east to a powder magazine. A secret escape tunnel leads south to a riverbank.
descriptions.51: You are in the powder magazine of this really super castle. A doorway leads west to a courtyard.
descriptions.52: You are on the eastern bank of an underground river. A tunnel leads north through the cliff face into a castle. A wooden bridge crosses the water west.
descriptions.53: A small wooden bridge crosses an underground river to the east. A narrow service path leads north towards a conduit.
descriptions.54: You are in a conduit draining into a river. Freezing water reaches your knees. A narrow service path leads south to a wooden bridge. Drains continue east into the cavern network.
